title: CLEANUP: memcmp with NUL-including lengths in CBOR decoder should be strcmp
description: src/wp11_keystore.c lines ~563, 571, 580, 598 in decode_cbor_payload: memcmp(key_name, "id", 3) compares 3 bytes including NUL; memcmp(key_name, "label", 6) compares 6 bytes including NUL, etc. The NUL-including count means the comparison only works because cbor_read_text always NUL-terminates key_name. This is fragile — the intent is string comparison but the form looks like length-prefixed binary comparison. It will cause a reader to do a double-take and may be changed incorrectly by a contributor who notices the apparent miscounting. Fix: replace all four memcmp calls with strcmp. Add a one-line comment above the map-key comparisons: 'cbor_read_text guarantees NUL-termination, so strcmp is safe here.'
